pf.license.need: none for the gym itself: the business registration and the owner's ID are on file; nothing is looked up
pf.license.staff: no state license for instructors; the gym's own instructor check, first aid and CPR, set by the owner and kept with their end dates (on file, not looked up)
pf.license.mobile wall: where the state's rules treat a mobile climbing wall as a ride: its inspection or permit kept with its end date as the wall's papers (S1-81); no event is offered past that date
pf.license.insurance: the gym's own liability cover; a host who asks for a certificate gets it from the business, outside Rosie
pf.license.job limits: the owner's own: the most climbers per staff member and the wall's most climbers at once

before times: How many climbers? (sets the class seats, the party size, or the wall's staff)

For a child: which class age band (6 to 12)? Never the exact age.
B: the event's address, and the ground and space at the spot (flat, 30 by 20 feet, truck access)
secure page only: the waiver for each climber: past injuries or health conditions the climber chooses to tell, an emergency contact
a child's name and the adults who may pick them up from a kids' class
pf.questions.who may book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child; climbers 14 to 17 may climb in open sessions only with a parent's or guardian's signed waiver; under 14 in open climbing only with an adult who stays in the gym; a teen never books alone (a parent books)

stop words: someone fell or is hurt now, a head injury, can't move, chest pain: the 911 safety message, no booking
drunk, high, or plans to climb after drinking: not today (no climbing under the influence)
pf.safety.tell the customer: Climbing has a real risk of falls and injury. Staff check every knot and belay; follow their checks. Wear clothes you can move in; rental shoes at the desk. No climbing after alcohol or drugs.
pf.safety.staff stops: a climber who fails a knot or belay check climbs only on bouldering and auto-belays that visit; an unsafe climber is stopped (the visit ends for safety)
pf.safety.booking continues: yes, after the safety steps, for anything but an emergency or intoxication
pf.safety.B: high wind, lightning or rain on the wall: climbing stops until it's safe; the operators decide on site

pf.first_steps.when: signed on the secure page before the first climb; on file for 12 months, so later bookings skip it
pf.first_steps.who: each climber for themselves; a parent or guardian for each child; at a party or an event each child's own parent
pf.first_steps.late: not signed by check-in: signs at the desk on the day, or doesn't climb

pf.first_steps.when: at the start of the first roped visit, about 15 minutes
pf.first_steps.who: climbers who want to belay or climb on ropes without staff
pf.first_steps.fail: climbs on bouldering and auto-belays that visit, or books the intro class; nothing extra is charged

pf.visit.check-in: the code at the front desk; a class or a party: names ticked on the roster; the waiver on file is checked at check-in
pf.visit.B check-in: the code at the event with the host; each climber's waiver checked at the wall
pf.visit.changes at the visit: rental shoes and harness priced at the desk ($6 and $5); a party's extra climbers at $25 each, OK'd by the person who booked
pf.visit.done: the desk or the coach texts DONE; a class: the roster
pf.visit.children: kids' classes: the child is left with the coach and handed only to an adult the parent listed; parties and open climbing: a parent or adult stays

pf.money.ways: day pass: nothing when booked, paid at the desk; classes and kids' classes: paid in full when booked; private coaching: card saved for the fee, paid at the desk; party: $100 deposit, rest at the desk; B event: $250 deposit, rest on the bill; B backyard party: paid in full
pf.money.packs: memberships and punch cards charged when bought; a credit pays one session or seat
pf.money.memberships: a membership charged monthly through Rosie: 1% of each charge to Rosie, no $2 on its members' classes; a member who pays at the desk: $2 per class at check-in (the owner can turn those bookings off)
pf.money.fees: the owner's own: free cancel until the owner's cutoff (flow A: 24 hours before; flow B events: 2 days before); after that or a no-show, a class keeps its price, coaching a $25 fee, a party its deposit, a wall its deposit; each asked of the owner
pf.money.caps: any deposit cap from the state form, as the owner's own rule
pf.money.reserved time: a class seat, a party, a coaching hour and the mobile wall are reserved time, charged in full: a customer who stops or leaves early gets nothing back for time not used (S13-55; any refund is the owner's call); a stop the gym makes for safety, like wind on the wall, is the gym's side for the part not given

pf.messages.never in a text: injuries, health conditions, pregnancy, a fall or an incident report, a child's name or age, waiver answers
pf.messages.minors: a child's details stay on the secure page; texts go to the parent who booked

pf.staff.skills: instructor (classes, coaching, belay checks), kids' coach, party host, mobile-wall operator, desk
pf.staff.ratios: a class: 1 instructor per 6 adults or 8 kids; a party: 1 staff belayer per 5 climbers; the mobile wall: 2 operators
pf.staff.stand-ins: any instructor with the skill may teach a class or a party (nobody is named); a coaching session that named a coach is never moved to another coach on silence
pf.staff.who OKs: the owner OKs prices, refunds and fees

switches: minimum ages per service: the owner's own
where the state's rules require it: the mobile wall's ride inspection or permit on file
a deposit cap where the state form names one
pf.rules.cancel: the owner's own rule; suggested: free until 24 hours before

pf.edges.late: a class starts on time; late more than 10 minutes to an intro class: the climber may miss the safety part and climb bouldering only (the owner's rule)
pf.edges.no-show: the owner decides any fee each time
pf.edges.too few: a class under its fewest at the cutoff: the owner runs it or cancels; a cancel returns everything paid
pf.edges.weather (B): wind or lightning stops the wall; the event can move or end; the owner decides any refund
pf.edges.injury: first aid by staff, 911 by staff if needed; the owner is told at once; nothing about it in texts
pf.edges.capacity: Rosie books only the spots the owner gives it per session, or reads them from the gym's own connected system
